summary: SKK Holdings Ltd filed a 6-K announcing an Extraordinary General Meeting on June 22, 2026, to approve an asset purchase from Rantizo, Inc. SKK will acquire substantially all of Rantizo's drone-based technology assets for $759,047 in cash plus newly issued Class A ordinary shares valued at approximately $258.8 million, implying a total consideration of roughly $259.6 million. The deal requires shareholder approval; no premium or advisor was stated. The structure involves a mix of cash and stock, with the Rantizo assets in agriculture, forestry, and emergency response. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory clearance. Risk-arb would monitor Nasdaq listing requirements given the large stock component.
